purpose: Validate a newly created Python environment and the synthetic-data GPU smoke path; this is not a full fine-tuning reproduction.

check.input: Synthetic one-example smoke data and a randomly initialized miniature Qwen3 model
check.optimizer_step: One CUDA optimizer step changed model weights

limits: The clean-environment smoke did not load the Qwen3-0.6B backbone.
It did not reproduce the historical 600-step training run or its metrics.
Transformers 5.16.1 was explicitly installed after requirements installation; requirements.txt remains a lower-bound list rather than a full environment lock.
One smoke run on one device does not establish compatibility or memory sufficiency on other GPUs.
